name: io.github.rare-disease-atlas/orphan-disease-opportunity-mcp
title: Orphan Disease Opportunity Atlas MCP
description: Myelofibrosis (JAK2+ & Autoimmune MF) flagship playbooks + live 7,000-orphan-disease diligence MCP.

tools.name: search_founder_opportunities
tools.title: Search Orphan Disease Startup & Translational Blueprints
tools.description: Search citation-verified orphan disease startup blueprints across computational AI-bio, public health/RWE, and biotech venture financing—anchored on Paired Flagships Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis (jak2-myelofibrosis) and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis + Iron/Hepcidin Overload (autoimmune-myelofibrosis).

wet_lab_required.description: Set false for zero-wet-lab AI/software/RWE or CRO-outsourced plays; omit for all.

tools.name: get_disease_case_study
tools.title: Get Curated Orphan Disease Translational Case Study
tools.description: Retrieve causal biology, standard-of-care failure cliffs (Flagships: Clonal JAK2 V617F+ JH2 vs JH1 Primary Myelofibrosis and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis AIMF + dual transfusional/hepcidin iron overload), FDA Orphan Drug unit economics, and open PDB/GEO/NCT accessions.

tools.name: list_non_dilutive_grants
tools.title: List Non-Dilutive SBIR, ARPA-H & Rare Disease Foundation Grants
tools.description: List stackable non-dilutive federal (NIH NCI/NHLBI SBIR/STTR, ARPA-H, FDA OOPD), rare-disease foundation (MPN Research Foundation, CDCN/Every Cure, Penn ODC), and venture-philanthropy (Blood Cancer United TAP) mechanisms.

tools.name: get_validation_communities
tools.title: Get Ethical Patient & Clinical Validation Communities
tools.description: Retrieve institutional registries, academic consortia, and patient foundations paired with mandatory non-extractive ethical engagement rules.

tools.name: get_90_day_validation_plan
tools.title: Get 90-Day Killer-Experiment & Grant Validation Plan
tools.description: Retrieve a structured 30/60/90-day validation roadmap, open GEO/PDB dataset checklist, CRO/FHIR budget, non-dilutive grant stack, and ethical patient advisory protocol for a founder persona and orphan indication (defaulting to Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships).

wet_lab_required.description: Whether internal wet-lab infrastructure is available (default: false).

tools.name: search_any_orphan_indication
tools.title: Search & Benchmark Any of 7,000+ Orphan Indications Live
tools.description: Run live federated diligence across all 7,000+ orphan diseases via OpenTargets Platform v4, ClinicalTrials.gov v2, and PubMed, paired with FY2026 FDA Orphan Drug / Rare Pediatric PRV unit economics and benchmarked against Clonal JAK2 V617F+ and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis.

disease_query.description: Any rare or orphan disease name or identifier (e.g., 'JAK2 V617F myelofibrosis', 'autoimmune myelofibrosis', 'VEXAS syndrome', 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy').

prompts.name: evaluate-rare-disease-venture
prompts.description: Multi-step 90-day killer-experiment, grant-stacking, and ethical validation workflow anchored on Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships.
